section_summary.extract_value: This section details the materials and methods for a cross-sectional face-to-face interview study conducted in Hofuf city, Saudi Arabia. The sample consisted of 207 women recruited from primary health centers using a convenience sampling technique. Data collection involved trained nutritionists conducting individual interviews and anthropometric measurements.
